name: – Joachim Streit – After § 6 – Am 12
title: REPORT on the financial activities of the European Investment Bank Group – annual report 2025
part_text: 6a. Warns against the use of the EIB and EIB-backed instruments as a mechanism for de facto budgetary mutualisation or for financing EU own resources outside the normal budgetary procedure; stresses that any reinforcement of the EIB’s role under the next multiannual financial framework must be subject to full parliamentary scrutiny;
